rows.text: Amazon selling blacklisted phones!. Phone is great. But this review is about Amazon selling stolen goods. Just found out from the carrier the reason I can't activate this phone on the network when I popped in the Sim card is because it's blacklisted.
Vodafone Italy carrier apps. I ordered the unlocked international version. I got the phone with Italian Vodafone carrier apps on it. Other than that everything's fine.

I think where we messed up, was in taking the phone into Verizon like they said we should "to marry the sim to the phone" I believe that is where we messed up. Ha we just popped sim card in ourselves they probably would not of been able to do what they did to my phone. One thing I will say. When buying an unlocked phone and putting in a sim card to a phone that had been previously a different company or factory unlocked. sometime not all the present companies features or apps will work. Such as the phone my husband is now using ( my old one bought on her e factory unlocked) can do video dialing, straight from the dialer. Mine cannot. Great phone, was not compatible with Verizon network. Great phone, was not compatible with Verizon network. They said some unlocked international work, some don't, it depended on the SIM EISN # . Not having access to the specific number who can check? My last unlocked international Samsung the S6 Edge+ worked just fine, this one did not... Buyer beware

NOT AS ADVERTISED. This is not a factory unlocked phone. It is an Xfinity (mobile carrier) phone that has been third party unlocked. I have had nothing but problems with this phone. Sent it in to SAMSUNG to try to fix it and they sent it back re-LOCKED. Now it is a locked Xfinity phone and I have contacted Amazon, Samsung, and Xfinity and all of them refuse to unlock it again. This phone is now unusable and absolutely useless to me.

Phone isn't working with other GSM sim card. Bought this phone thinking that being an unlocked phone, it will be work in Africa as long as I insert a GSM sim card but to my disappointment the message I received was that my sim card is not from verizon wireless. Does it need to be activated on the verizon network?

Before long a notice popped up that the SIM card had changed, and that the system would need to be cleared to use it. I said yes, and after the restart no more Verizon - it was replaced by the Tracfone screen. I then activated the SIM online, changed over my number to the new phone, and within an hour I was back in business. So in my case I got exactly what I was expecting, even better really, since the phone is in such great condition. Time will tell if it holds up, but so far so good.

Beautiful phone but; not GSM & Not unlocked. I love the phone; best pictures ever and is easy to use. Don't like that Google is installed and practically takes over phone. Biggest problem is it was supposed to be unlocked and a GSM phone but instead it is a Verizon phone that is not unlocked. Seller told me there was nothing they could do. First time i've been very disappointed with a purchase on Amazon and it was an expensive one. I've been an Amazon customer and fan for years and also a Subscribe & Save customer. My first review they blocked so we'll see if this one goes through. Should be able to report false advertising by sellers so others can beware.
Get a sim card. Comes with everything but a sim card which was a bit disappointing since it said it's a Sprint brand phone, but only a minor inconvenience. Everything else seems to be holding up fine

Great screen, battery, and Bixby has potential.. Great phone that has all the features you're looking for in a flagship, but also with Dual-Sim. Just FYI, here in the US ATT doesn't support dual-sim (rolling my eyes) so you can't have them work at the same time. For the record my personal is T-Mobile, work is ATT. Dual-SIm is active, however, it's via call forwarding because of ATT's lack of support. The phone comes unlocked which is great if you root your phone. Overall, I'm happy with the phone, as I am moving from Nexus devices to Sammy.

Got a brand new Galaxy8Plus AT&T Branded, boxed, with AT&T documentation. HAPPY!!. Took the crap phone (not the S8+) back to AT&T for a full refund (last day to return) Those remora took me for $280.00 on a crappy Samsung that went for $67.00 on Prime day. I ended up getting the S8+ and am very happy with it. It came as AT&T with correct barcodes and handset numbers which kind of pissed the AT&T guy. Got him more riled when I told him the S8+ he was activating was only AT&T branded he seemed disappointed. I think he was hoping I'd have come in with an international unlocked phone that they don't have to service. Works fine and couldn't be happier.
Truely Unlocked!. This phone is very nice as new phones are. The best part is that it works on my GSM network (Consumer Cellular) without a hitch! Thank you for honest advertising!

I had the average sized one in my s5 and needed to go to my provider to exchange SIMs Update: after 3 months of having the phone, I started to get a "no network connection" message and the phone stopped recognizing my Sim card. I bought a new Sim to see if that helped and it didn't. I even did a network reset and a hard reset on the phone to no avail. The phone is completely useless unless I'm connected to wifi. I can no longer receive texts or calls. I have read that some of the phones have this same problem. Maybe I'm just one of the unlucky ones. It was great while it lasted, but I can't help to feel cheated out of my money.

NOTICE! This item was NOT unlocked!!! Seller doesn't call or email back to help.. I spent hours figuring out with my service provider on why the SIM wasn't working. Turns out this phone IS NOT UNLOCKED! The logo that pops up when turning on the phone is the prior service provider. You'll have to end up having the previous owner call their service provider to unlock it. Good luck with that. I would NOT recommend buying from this seller until they verify ALL of their unlocked phones are UNLOCKED. Fair warning!
Love the phone but I can get it activated on my Verizon Network! This will be getting returned!
